## SYRIAN ARAB REPUBLIC — profile (page 222)

- **Header facts:** Region: **Middle East, North Africa, Afghanistan & Pakistan**; Income group: **Low-income**; Lending category: **IDA**; Data status: **Preliminary data (P)**; Population: **25.6 million**; GNI: **22,933**; Unit line: **US$ million, unless otherwise indicated**.
- **Total external debt stock, 2025:** **5,950**, **+4.2% from 2024**.

- **Figure 1. Total external debt, 2015–25:**  
  Printed start/end values: **4,824** (2015) and **5,950** (2025). The line is broadly upward: nearly flat at the start, rising through the late 2010s, reaching a local peak around **≈2021**, dipping **≈2022**, edging up **≈2023**, dipping slightly **≈2024**, and rising again to the period high in **2025**.

  - **Debt service / GNI:** **0.0%**, **+483.4%**; the line stays near zero throughout 2015–22 with a slight uptick by **2022**.
